_documentation.model_purpose: 11th METAR Station: DXY (US Dollar Index) — Harmonized V3 with dual-layer architecture.
_documentation.return_formula_standard: R_fwd = (Close_{t+k} - Close_t) / Close_t for k in [1, 3, 5] — Bayesian Laplace Shrinkage m=10
_documentation.return_formula_kinematic: R_net = log(P_end / P_start) * 100 on pure confirmed Neon Vault ZigZag legs (SPY) — Bayesian Laplace Shrinkage m=10

intermarket_mechanics.dxy_up: Global Liquidity Squeeze + Commodity Deflation + EM Debt Stress + Corporate Margin Compression
intermarket_mechanics.dxy_down: EM Capital Inflow + Commodity Inflation (Oil/Gold Cost-Push) + Reflation + Weaker Import Costs

dual_layer_architecture.standard_layer: zz25/zz50/zz75 — fwd_1d/3d/5d bar returns with Bayesian Shrinkage. Compatible with convergence_compositor.py.
dual_layer_architecture.kinematic_layer: zigzag_kinematic.zz25/zz50/zz75 — Physical ZigZag leg metrics + structural_momentum. Bayesian regularized.

_documentation.d1_classification: Expanding Window Percentile Rank (zero look-ahead bias), mapped to Gaussian sigma bins
_documentation.state_hierarchy: L0=Station -> L1=D1(Absolute Level) -> L2=D2(Velocity 72h) -> L3=D3(Vol Magnitude)

zigzag_kinematic.purpose: Physical confirmed ZigZag leg metrics per scale, Bayesian regularized.

structural_momentum.purpose: MIN→MIN (Higher/Lower Lows) and MAX→MAX (Higher/Lower Highs) accumulated returns and inter-turning-point duration.

confidence_tier.LOW: N=3-5 — Direction reliable, magnitude not. Sizing ×0.5

field_glossary.n: Sample count of daily bars in state
field_glossary.n_raw: Sample count of forward return observations (standard layer)
field_glossary.n_pos: Number of bullish MIN->MAX physical legs (kinematic layer)
field_glossary.n_neg: Number of bearish MAX->MIN physical legs (kinematic layer)
field_glossary.p_bull: Bayesian smoothed probability of positive return/bullish leg
field_glossary.e_ret_max: Average positive return (standard) or average bullish leg log return % (kinematic)
field_glossary.e_ret_min: Average negative return (standard) or average bearish leg log return % (kinematic)
field_glossary.e_days: Duration: 1/3/5 days (standard) or median physical leg duration (kinematic)
field_glossary.confidence_tier: Statistical confidence classification based on N
field_glossary.operational_guidance: Sizing code from Universal Institutional Taxonomy

_documentation.signal_interpretation_policy: Pure domain adapters interpret probabilities dynamically. Clean Architecture Standard.
